name: Lenawee County, MI
findings: Lenawee County has 316 nonprofit organizations. 125 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 105 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lenawee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: No economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Lenawee County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
